title: Revisão final de recibos de texto legado — p.57
scopeLimits: Mantém exatamente as traduções e dados rich-text já publicados; esta revisão só atualiza recibos de Copyfit e aprovação.
Não traduz nomes impressos em cartas ou componentes.

terminologyEvidence.note: Nenhuma mudança de redação; validação contra a terminologia já aprovada e o texto-fonte oficial.

candidates.sourceText: Unique Loot is a special type of Combatant Loot Card. Unique Items represent special Items in Middara that are incredibly difficult to obtain.
candidates.proposalText: Saque Único é um tipo especial de Carta de Saque de Combatente. Itens Únicos representam Itens especiais de Middara, extremamente difíceis de obter.

segments.text: Combatente. Itens Únicos representam Itens especiais d

candidates.editorialStatus: Existing approved terminology and card/component scope preserved; certify current translation without changing wording.

100%.method: scripts/measure_copyfit_page.mjs: PyMuPDF spans are first grouped by their source line object, then distinct source lines are grouped by representative baseline (1 pt tolerance). Rich runs in one line object remain one visual row. Inline uppercase callout markers and a separate Cinzel quantity glyph beside a declared weapon-hand symbol are folded into the adjacent prose row only when their ink boxes overlap. Live PT-BR PageRenderer text rects plus visible semantic-symbol rects for symbol-only rows are clustered by vertical centre (0.5 x median rect height); inline symbols overlapping a text row count with that row, not as extra lines. Candidate text and symbol IDs must match the selected renderer unit. For image-backed/raster-restored source text whose PDF extraction is incomplete, a candidate-scoped sourceVisualLineCountOverride may be used only with documented visual evidence. No character count, string newline count or frame-height estimate was used.

candidates.sourceText: Monster Loot Items are not only useful as Items, but they also have the MATERIAL Tag printed on them. Materials are required to Unlock Item Upgrades so that they can be purchased during the Shop and Train Phase of a Story Round. See Item Upgrades Pg. 28.
candidates.proposalText: Os Itens de Saque de Monstro também trazem a etiqueta MATERIAL. Materiais são necessários para desbloquear Aprimoramentos de Item, que podem ser comprados durante a fase Comprar e Treinar de uma Rodada de História. Veja Aprimoramentos de Item, p. 28.
